input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Customer. Clause 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, or license any product or service and engage any supplier, and confirms Customer has made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment; clause 2.1 adds that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that declining to place further Order Forms is not a breach. The only exclusivity-type restraint (12.4, Vendor not competing with Customer's analytics products) runs in Customer's favour and is acceptable per the detection guidance. Remaining "exclusive" references relate to jurisdiction and remedies, not dealing restrictions. Preferred position met; no redline required.
